description: This file defines an interface for managing session interactions with Amazon DynamoDB within the AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies methods for reading, writing, deleting, and garbage collecting session data.

classes.name: SessionConnectionInterface
classes.description: Interface specifying methods for session management operations with DynamoDB, including reading, writing, deleting, and cleanup of expired sessions.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data from DynamoDB for the given session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores session data into DynamoDB with the specified session ID, data, and change status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes the session record identified by the session ID from DynamoDB.

methods.name: deleteExpired
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to delete expired sessions from DynamoDB.
